name: amazon-keyword-competitor-monitor
description: Amazon 关键词竞品价格与排名监控系统
author: Amazon Monitor Team

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.build:tauri:web: npm run build:shared && cross-env VITE_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:4000/api npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/web run build
scripts.test:unit: npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/shared run test && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/api run test:unit && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/api run build && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/api run build && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/web run build
